about: Pages read again on the facsimile for issue 145 and earlier revision passes. One entry per (folder, batch, pass, scope). Maintained by hand and by the revision passes; see PRIORITIES.md.

scopes.blind: page read a second time without the existing text, then diffed
scopes.full: whole page compared with the existing text
scopes.statements: statements and formulas compared with the existing text; prose of proofs and struck text not
scopes.flags: only the places marked \uncertain or \ill were looked at
